trigger: HLL approx dup counter flagged 9 events > 5% (row 7 coarse tripwire) on the full pass
method: exact strict-key COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT) scoped to the 9 flagged events (one extra filtered_trades scan, run once). Strict key = (ticker, event_date, ROUND(momentum_pct,2), sip_timestamp, price, size, sequence_number) - identical to the pass key and Phase 6c A8/T3''. Reproduced by research/phase_6b/a63a_dup_recheck.py.
finding: Genuine exact-duplicate prints exist in filtered_trades for 7 events - identical rows on (ticker, event_date, momentum_pct, sip_timestamp, price, size, sequence_number). These are ingestion duplicates, 6.7-19.6% of each event's prints. All 7 are 2022-01 events (SCWO, CETY, NUKK); NUKK is a known degraded/sidecar ticker. Duplicate prints inflate volume and n_trades for these events but do NOT alter the price path (a duplicate has the same price at the same timestamp), so the opportunity-decay (price-anchored) measurement is unaffected for them; volume-based measures (concentration, min-window, segment shares) are inflated for these 7 events only. Previously undetected: Phase 6c's exact dup check was dev-tier only (56 events, none of these) - A8.2's full-pass dup-print requirement is exactly what surfaced it.
impact_on_measurement: Negligible on pooled/population results (7 of 15,763 events). Price-path decay unaffected. The 7 events' own volume-based stats are inflated by their dup rate.
scope_caveat: Only the 9 events above the 5% coarse flag were exact-checked. Real duplication BELOW 5% sits under the HLL per-event noise floor (~2% on the clean dev tier) and cannot be distinguished from noise without a broader exact audit, which would cost additional full filtered_trades scans (no index). So 7 is a LOWER BOUND on the number of affected events. A broader >2% audit was attempted and abandoned for scan cost.
escalation: Row 7 (dup-print) tripped and is CONFIRMED as real duplication, not HLL noise. This is a data-quality finding requiring Cooper's disposition (flag-and-proceed / dedup / exclude / investigate ingestion source) - a hard stop per the escalation table.
